svg.text: Timing — 110.8 s to 18.45 s, every step measured on silicon
Frame time, bit-exact at CRC 0x319037b2 throughout
Current stage split — no dominant stage remains
FFT-2 = the RANGE transform, CT#2 hidden inside
Two clock domains: fabric 100 MHz (setup slack +0.182 ns on a ~9.82 ns path — essentially none left) and
CoreFFT SLOWCLK 12.5 MHz (+67.8 ns). Raising the fabric clock needs path surgery first, not optimism.
